articles.summary: HAMILTON, BERMUDA, September 14, 2026 – DHT Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:DHT) (“DHT” or the “Company”) today announced it has entered into a three-year time charter agreement at $100,000 per day for the VLCC DHT Panther, built in 2016. The contract is expected to commence in October 2026 and has been concluded with a global energy company. About […]
articles.title: DHT Holdings, Inc. secures three-year time charter for DHT Panther
